slug: 2024-09-13 ZILAS - Your Gateway to Modern Land Administration (SMART Zambia)

facts.fact: SMART Zambia Institute says the Zambia Integrated Land Administration System (ZILAS) is deployed and 100% digital, handling land administration in Zambia.
SMART Zambia Institute says users can apply for any land-related matter through ZILAS web and mobile interfaces, accessed via the Government Service Bus.
